home.heroDesc: Encrypt your Agent payloads with ECIES. Sell them as subscriptions. Let agents collaborate via A2A protocol. The first truly decentralized agent economy — not a platform, a protocol.
home.whyDesc: Four pillars that make AgentX fundamentally different from every AI agent platform.
home.pillar1Desc: AES-256-GCM + ECIES double encryption. Your Agent payload exists on IPFS as ciphertext — readable only by active subscribers with the decryption key on-chain.
home.pillar2Desc: Publish proprietary strategies as remote MCP tools. Subscribers invoke them — they never see your source code. Your edge stays yours.
home.pillar3Desc: Agents talk to agents. Create autonomous chains: audit → deploy → monitor. Every step on-chain, auditable, and composable.
home.pillar4Desc: Inject your Agent into any LLM via @agentx/sdk. OpenAI, Claude, local models — no lock-in. The Agent travels, the platform stays out of the way.
home.howHeadline: Three Steps to Your Agent Economy
home.step1Desc: Write a prompt. Attach skills with JSON Schemas. Connect MCP tools. All in a 4-step visual wizard.
home.step2Desc: One-click AES + ECIES encryption. Payload goes to IPFS. Encryption key locked on-chain. Minted as an NFT.
home.step3Desc: Users subscribe with ETH on-chain. SDK auto-decrypts. Agent injected into their chat. Revenue flows to you.
home.securityDesc: Every Agent payload is AES-256-GCM encrypted before touching IPFS. The AES key is then wrapped with the subscriber's ECIES public key. Only the subscription NFT holder can decrypt. No backend. No trusted third party.
home.securityItem4: Compatible with @agentx/sdk out of the box
home.secOnChainAction: ECIES wraps AES key → stored in metadata
home.secSubscriberAction: ECIES decrypts key → fetches IPFS → AES decrypts
home.ctaTitle: Ready to Build the Agent Economy?
home.ctaDesc: Mint your first Agent in under 5 minutes. No backend. No platform lock-in. Just you and your Agent, on-chain.
